API returns the unique task_id

performance: The API should respond to requests within 200 milliseconds under normal load.
The system should handle up to 1000 concurrent users.
security: All sensitive data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
User passwords must be hashed and salted.
scalability: The system should be able to scale horizontally to accommodate increased load.
Database should support sharding to manage large datasets.
usability: The API should have clear and concise documentation.
Error messages should be user-friendly and informative.
reliability: The system should have an uptime of 99.9%.
Data backups should occur daily to prevent data loss.

constraints: The API must comply with GDPR regulations for user data.
The system must be developed using the specified technology stack.
success_criteria: User satisfaction rating of at least 80% based on feedback.
All functional requirements are met and pass acceptance testing.

risks.risk: Potential data breaches due to inadequate security measures.
risks.mitigation: Implement strong encryption and regular security audits.
Conduct load testing and optimize database queries.

assumptions: Users will have access to the internet to use the API.
Users will have basic knowledge of using web applications.
dependencies: Third-party authentication service for user login.
Database service for storing tasks and user information.

ask_first: Make API calls to external services
